ayahs.text: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
ayahs.translation: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered

ayahs.text: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
ayahs.translation: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing

ayahs.text: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
ayahs.translation: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
ayahs.translation: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
ayahs.translation: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur

ayahs.text: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
ayahs.translation: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly

ayahs.text: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
ayahs.translation: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading

ayahs.text: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
ayahs.translation: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him

ayahs.text: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
ayahs.translation: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you

ayahs.text: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
ayahs.translation: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate

ayahs.text: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
ayahs.translation: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy

ayahs.text: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
ayahs.translation: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire

ayahs.text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
ayahs.translation: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold

ayahs.text: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
ayahs.translation: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down

ayahs.text: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
ayahs.translation: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

ayahs.text: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
ayahs.translation: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds)

ayahs.text: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
ayahs.translation: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil

ayahs.text: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
ayahs.translation: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil

ayahs.text: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
ayahs.translation: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls

ayahs.text: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.translation: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate

ayahs.text: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
ayahs.translation: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
ayahs.translation: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance

ayahs.text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation

ayahs.text: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
ayahs.translation: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever

ayahs.text: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening

ayahs.text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
ayahs.translation: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day

ayahs.text: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
ayahs.translation: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord

ayahs.text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
ayahs.translation: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise

ayahs.text: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
ayahs.translation: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom
